result.summary: Found 2 visual issues. The main problem is an incorrect active navigation state; horizontal carousel content also appears awkwardly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights “Profile” in green even though the visible page is clearly the Home/discovery feed. “Home” is shown as inactive.
issues.suggestion: Synchronize the selected navigation state with the current route: highlight Home and render Profile as inactive on this page.

issues.description: Horizontal carousels are clipped abruptly at the right viewport edge. A partial empty category pill and a heavily cut-off restaurant card/title are visible, making the layout look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel item widths, gaps, and right-side padding so the next item has a deliberate, consistent preview or is fully outside the viewport.
